depiction.composition: single square inbox icon with bottom-right badge overlay

readings.meaning: email filter, wildcard rule, or custom inbox routing
mandatory form submission or required document intake

reasoning: The icon combines an inbox tray containing text lines with a bold asterisk badge, naturally signifying priority/starred inbox items, wildcard email filters, or mandatory intake forms. While useful for email triage and routing tasks, the inbox base is somewhat cramped by the large cutout and can resemble a generic note or form at small sizes.
